updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Version Trimming for Retained Files
updates.summary: SharePoint and OneDrive admins can now enable automatic trimming of file versions created by retention policies, reclaiming storage without breaking compliance holds or legal-hold promises. Admins with appropriate Purview RBAC roles will control this via a policy-scoped setting that overrides the default version-retention behavior.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph will provide unified access to both Main and Auxiliary Archive mailboxes before EWS Graph APIs deprecate in October 2026, giving users a seamless archive view across multiple physical mailbox locations. This modernizes API access for archive data management and compliance scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection – Auto-Labeling for Legacy Office Formats
updates.summary: Server-side auto-labeling in Microsoft Purview will now support legacy Office file formats (.doc, .xls, .ppt) in SharePoint and OneDrive, automatically evaluating and applying sensitivity labels to these older files. This extends classification capabilities to organizations with legacy document repositories.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint data loss prevention now monitors and restricts sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols based on configured policies, extending DLP protection beyond HTTP-based channels. Admins must configure these transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to enforce controls on these legacy protocols.

updates.title: Multiple Authorization Vulnerabilities Patched in Microsoft Edge (Chromium)
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge ingested 11 Chromium vulnerabilities related to missing or incorrect authorization across multiple components (Video, Downloads, BFCache, Extensions, Core, USB, SiteIsolation, Chromoting, BrowserTag, WebProtect, Select). Admins should ensure Edge is updated to the latest version to close these authorization bypasses.
